messages:
clare (finance): Stratum Labs invoice INV-2026-901 ($6,120) shows as unpaid; Stripe shows a charge failure and a pending dispute. AP says they attempted payment but got a decline. Can AE confirm card on file and any dispute reason?

diego (acct-exec): Pinged Andrew at payments@stratumlabs.com. Stripe webhook shows `card_declined` then `charge.refunded` after a disputed charge. I asked Andrew for a transaction ID and whether they want to retry card or send ACH.

andrew (Stratum Labs): Sorry — we saw an unexpected duplicate charge and opened a dispute last night. Our billing team will drop the dispute if you can provide evidence of a single invoice and the service usage for March. We can retry the card once dispute is resolved or do an ACH. Which do you prefer?

clare (finance): For collections, ACH will be fastest to get funds credited. If you want us to provide usage detail to lift the dispute, we can send the March usage report and invoice PDF. If you choose ACH, we need at least a 30% partial payment ($1,836) posted by 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC to avoid auto-suspension.

diego (acct-exec): Also can offer a one-time waiver of the $75 late fee if they post ACH for 100% within 48 hours of the remittance. Andrew - confirm which route and we'll prepare docs.

andrew (Stratum Labs): We prefer ACH to simplify bookkeeping. Will your team accept remittance proof (bank confirmation) and then we'll drop the dispute on our side? We'll route $6,120 by ACH in one transfer.

samantha (legal): Quick note: if dispute remains open and we see chargeback, we need a signed acknowledgment before re-billing charge. If they drop dispute after remittance proof, we can mark account current and not pursue further. Also confirm any credit/waiver in writing.

clare (finance): Understood. @andrew please attach remittance PDF (mask account numbers) when you initiate ACH. We'll accept the remittance as proof and proceed to clear the dispute. If only partial payment shown, we'll hold per the 30% rule above.

ops-bot: Alert: If outstanding balance > $0 on account "stratum-labs" after 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC, scheduled suspension of API keys will occur. Use `/payments status INV-2026-901` to refresh.

diego (acct-exec): I'll email the waiver confirmation and ACH instructions to Andrew now and cc finance/legal.

andrew (Stratum Labs): Sending remittance to the email in 10m. We plan ACH today and will upload confirmation here once bank sends the receipt. Thank you for working with us.

clare (finance): Thanks. Keeping thread open until remittance or dispute drop confirmed. If dispute remains after 04/12 we'll escalate per collections policy.
